description: This file defines the Customer class within the Opencart system, providing methods for managing customer data, including login, logout, session management, and retrieving customer details and statistics.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents a customer and provides methods for customer authentication, session management, and retrieving customer information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the customer object, loads customer data if session exists.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a customer by email and password, supports rehashing password if needed, and updates session data.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears customer session and resets customer properties.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Checks if a customer is currently logged in.

methods.name: getNewsletter
methods.description: Returns whether the customer is subscribed to the newsletter.

methods.name: isSafe
methods.description: Indicates if the customer is marked as safe.

methods.name: isCommenter
methods.description: Indicates if the customer has commenter privileges.

methods.name: getAddressId
methods.description: Retrieves the default address ID for the customer.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Returns the total balance for the customer.

methods.name: getRewardPoints
methods.description: Returns the total reward points for the customer.
